description: Re-screen a whole customer, supplier or payee list against sanctions and US export-control lists in one call. Up to 100 names vs OFAC, EU and UK lists (UN via EU/UK) and optionally the US Consolidated Screening List. Per name: no_match, possible_match, confirmed_match or unable_to_determine with confidence, sources and top matches. Name-only matching: review every match. Use for onboarding backlogs or periodic re-screening. $0.50 per batch of up to 100 names, USDC on Base (x402).

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: batch_sanctions_screen
